# Prompt Fix Metadata

## Overview

This skill wraps the `prompt_fix_metadata.py` script in `~/AppData/Local/hermes/scripts/`.

## Script Location

**Path:** `~/AppData/Local/hermes/scripts/prompt_fix_metadata.py`

## Usage

```bash
python $LOCALAPPDATA/hermes/scripts/prompt_fix_metadata.py
```

## Common Options

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `--help` | Display help |
| `--dry-run` | Preview changes |
| `--verbose` | Debug output |

## Examples

```bash
python $LOCALAPPDATA/hermes/scripts/prompt_fix_metadata.py --help
```
